messages:
mara: Quick thread to finalize benchmark narrative and routing for the next benchmark webinar. Need distinct hooks for GAU (growth) vs enterprise pipeline.
elin: GAU: show a single-panel "latency -> conversion" microstory with one clear metric (median p50) + cost-per-1k tokens callout. Keep headline < 10 words.
samir: Enterprise: focus on predictability: reserved capacity, SLA options, and a small table showing cost vs committed throughput.
mara: For creative, we want 3 chart assets: email sparkline (small), hero waterfall (cost by model+quant), and a compact KPI card (p50/p95/cost).
jonathan: FYI for routing: HubSpot form will include hidden field utm_segment and a required "company_size" dropdown. Workflow rules: company_size<=50 -> ga_team, 51-500 -> growth_reps, >500 -> enterprise_ae.
nina: We'll also add a Drift rule: if visitor viewed /enterprise and domain matches our account list, show contact-sales playbook.
elin: Copy tests: variant A (product-first) = "Ship faster. Save on tokens." Variant B (outcome-first) = "Faster UX, higher conversion, lower cost." We'll A/B in email subject and landing hero.
samir: Methodology note must be short and visible: bullets: model family, seq length, batch, quant, caching. Legal: no absolutes. Example: "Tested on LlamaX-7B, seq=1024, batch=16, q8_0 quant, KV cache on; results vary by workload."
mara: Good. Nina, can you add UTM naming: utm_campaign=bench_jun2026, utm_term=variantA|variantB, utm_content=chart_spark|hero_waterfall?
nina: Yep. Also tag the GA event bench_chart_view with variant and segment.
jonathan: Charts: please export SVG for sparkline (email friendly), PNG@2x for hero, and a compressed JPEG for paid ads. Also attach CSV with raw numbers so analytics can verify.
elin: For the hero waterfall, include a tiny legend that explains quantization shorthand (q8_0, q4_0) and a tooltip mock in the slide notes.
mara: CTA mapping: free_credits -> company_size<=100 OR self_serve checkbox; schedule_capacity_consult -> enterprise_ae. Also add a mid-funnel CTA "see pricing scenarios" for 100-500.
samir: I'll produce a metrics slice tonight: median p50 baseline (open-source host) vs our serving setup, plus cost per 1k tokens across model variants. Will post CSV.
elin: Webinar flow: 20m demo, 10m customer story, 15m Q&A. Keep targeted Q&A breakouts: mkt asks for 2 breakout prompts for each segment.
mara: Promotion cadence: 3 emails (announce / demo tease / last chance), 4 social posts staggered, 1 community post, 1 partner co-email. Schedule to start 10 days before.
nina: We'll run subject line A/B and creative A/B. Also add an experiment that swaps hero waterfall with KPI card on the landing page for half the traffic.
jonathan: Quick technical: ensure the landing page includes an expandable methodology accordion (collapsed by default) with the code block example: ```Model: LlamaX-7B | seq=1024 | batch=16 | q=8 | KV cache=on```
elin: Also prepare a recorded backup demo in case the live demo has infra flakiness. Include a transcript and a short clip for social.
samir: Posted CSV and a short summary: p50 baseline 360ms -> our p50 88ms (SMB sample), p95 baseline 1.2s -> our p95 320ms. Cost delta per 1k tokens: -$0.85 on typical prompt. CSV link: internal/bench/2681045678_results.csv
mara: Nice. We'll use the numbers but add the legal caveat phrasing. Also create a 2-line plain-English explanation for social creative so non-technical readers get it.
nina: I'll wire HubSpot flows and share draft rules. Also will set up tracking in GA/Amplitude.
announce-bot: Reminder: webinar set for 2026-06-12 16:00 UTC. Recording permissions: public.
mara: Action items recap: Samir -> final CSV + one-slide metric summary by EOD; Elin -> demo backup + transcript; Nina -> HubSpot flows + tracking; Jonathan -> press/PR bullets; Mara -> finalize slide copy and creative brief. Recheck in tomorrow standup.
jonathan: One more: propose a small paid test targeting dev forums with hero KPI card. Budget $500.
mara: Approved. Nina add to promo calendar. Thanks team. :rocket:
